normal.name: Marcus Adams
normal.text: Man, #AMD FSR has gotten "really" good. It's finally good enough that I don't mind using it to run games internally at lower resolutions so I can turn on ray tracing and still keep a consistent 60 fps. Here's some screenshots with the resolution in alt text. The game is set to all high. The non-FSR screenshots are using TSR anti-aliasing. The shadows and such may be slightly different in these because of cloud and character movement. #Gaming #PCGaming
normal.media: 3 images: 1080p native / 720p native / 1080p output, with FSR quality mode, meaning the input image is actually 720p, and FSR is scaling it up to 1080p.
